extras: A separate payment each year for birthday presents
A further payment for festival presents, such as at Christmas or Eid
A paid break of up to four weeks a year, separate from the family holiday
Exemption from council tax for carers who live in Thurrock and foster with Thurrock Council
summary: Thurrock publishes one weekly total per child that combines the maintenance payment for the child's costs with the carer's reward payment, for amounts applying from 1 April 2026. Care Skills is the standard rate and Care Skills+ is for children with more complex needs; a higher High Need Rate, with a £310 weekly reward payment, is paid in exceptional circumstances.
